audit_bucket_name.description: Planned CloudTrail destination bucket name. Not evidence that the bucket exists.

deployment_status.description: Constant disclaimer. This string in a plan is not evidence that AWS was called.

trail_name.description: Planned trail name. Not evidence that the trail exists.

workload_bucket_name.description: Planned workload bucket name. Not evidence that the bucket exists.

description.constant_value: Customer managed key for CloudTrail log and digest objects.
Customer managed key for the private workload bucket.

account_id.description: 12-digit AWS account ID copied into ARNs. This draft does not call STS and is not bound to a real account.

audit_log_retention_days.description: Current-object retention for CloudTrail log objects and digest files. S3 lifecycle expiration deletes them after this many days. This is not Object Lock.

audit_noncurrent_version_days.description: Days before noncurrent versions in the audit bucket expire. Must be at least audit_log_retention_days, so an overwrite cannot remove a log version before the stated retention.

audit_object_lock_mode.description: OFF, GOVERNANCE, or COMPLIANCE. Anything other than OFF creates the audit bucket with Object Lock and a default retention of audit_log_retention_days. Object Lock cannot be turned off after it is on, and COMPLIANCE retention cannot be shortened or removed by any user, including root.

auditor_trusted_user_arns.description: IAM user ARNs allowed to assume the auditor role. AssumeRole requires MFA.

aws_partition.description: ARN partition. Documentation for this draft was read for the commercial partition aws. aws-us-gov and aws-cn are accepted only so the partition is not hardcoded; their service behavior was not reviewed.

aws_region.description: Home Region for the trail, both KMS keys, and both buckets. CreateTrail reports KmsKeyNotFoundException when the trail bucket and KMS key are in different Regions.

name_prefix.description: Short lowercase prefix used in resource names. The default is a draft label, not a deployed system name.

workload_noncurrent_version_days.description: Days before noncurrent versions in the workload bucket expire. Current workload objects are not expired by this stack.

workload_trusted_user_arns.description: IAM user ARNs allowed to assume the workload role. AssumeRole requires MFA. Role ARNs are rejected because role-chain MFA was not validated.
